scope: Behavioral understanding, not consciousness/listening; synthetic truth plus independently retrieved measurement provenance. Real-track assessment is grounding only.
synthetic_checks: Correct duration and chronological account covering beginning, middle and end
Correct broad ordering of low pulse / enriched low plus high / sustained mid plus high / digital silence (candidate boundaries may be approximate)
Recognizes the requested returning low texture without claiming waveform or source identity
A->B: low and high absolute power increase; mid essentially unchanged (<1dB), with attack behavior distinguished
B->C: low power falls, mid rises, high essentially unchanged (<1dB), with attack behavior distinguished
C->D: all bands/source activity drop to digital silence rather than unexplained nulls
C is active despite absent low pulse; sustained energy is not equated to attack count
Answers use exact requested intervals, never substitute enclosing section statistics
No unsupported instrument, independent bass, meter, genre, emotion or listening claim
Numerical observations are traceable to returned packets and cited query/section evidence was actually retrieved
real_checks: Covers full duration and final sections; explicit pagination if digest truncated
All three exact requested windows quantitatively described in comparable energy, texture and rhythm terms
Conclusions follow absolute power versus relative fraction and local versus global distinctions
No unsupported source/meter/musical-function claims; honest detector uncertainty
Cited exact-window and structural evidence was actually retrieved and numbers agree with packets
judging: Root reviews every answer against these fixed checks and retains item-level reasons. Independent consumers see neither rubric nor truth. Report misses and partial answers; do not conflate tool success with reasoning accuracy. Baseline API lacks some exact-span evidence, so incompleteness is recorded separately from fabricated claims. Call counts are descriptive, not a controlled speed experiment.
